categories.main_business_segments: ILJINDIAMOND CO., LTD operates primarily in the manufacturing and sales of industrial synthetic diamonds and precision materials including Poly Crystalline Diamond (PCD), Poly Crystalline Boron Nitride (PCBN), and Tungsten Carbide products. The company also has a subsidiary, ILJIN HYSOLUS, engaged in hydrogen storage tanks for fuel cell vehicles and environmental products like diesel particulate filters (DPF). The main business divisions are the diamond business segment and the cemented carbide (hard metal) segment, with additional activities in hydrogen and environmental solutions through subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes high-pressure, high-temperature synthesis technology developed jointly with the Korea Institute of Science and Technology to produce synthetic diamonds and related materials. It employs advanced manufacturing processes for diamond grit, PCD, PCBN, and tungsten carbide products, including coating technologies (e.g., titanium coating), sintering, and composite material molding. ILJIN HYSOLUS develops Type 4 hydrogen storage tanks using carbon fiber composite materials with high-pressure design and safety features, alongside environmental technology for emission reduction devices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ILJINDIAMOND serves industrial sectors including machinery, metalworking, automotive, construction, mining, electronics, semiconductor, solar, and LED industries. Its products are used in cutting, grinding, and polishing tools for these industries. ILJIN HYSOLUS primarily supplies hydrogen storage tanks to automotive OEMs, notably Hyundai Motor Company, and targets commercial vehicles, drones, and hydrogen refueling infrastructure. The environmental segment serves government and local authorities for emission reduction devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Chungbuk and Jeonbuk provinces. It has overseas subsidiaries and sales offices in Japan, USA, Europe (Germany), China, and Vietnam to support global sales and distribution. Its products are exported worldwide, with significant markets in Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: ILJINDIAMOND operates upstream and midstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer of core synthetic diamond materials and precision cutting tool substrates. ILJIN HYSOLUS functions as a component supplier in the hydrogen fuel cell vehicle supply chain, producing critical hydrogen storage tanks and emission control devices, positioning itself as a key tier-1 supplier to OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in advanced synthetic diamond materials, including ultra-fine diamond powders, coated diamonds, and large-diameter sintered compacts. It invests in developing high-performance PCD and PCBN grades for difficult-to-machine materials and semiconductor wafer processing. ILJIN HYSOLUS focuses on lightweight, high-pressure hydrogen storage tanks, safety certification, and expanding applications to commercial vehicles and hydrogen mobility. The firm actively files patents globally to protect innovations and enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of synthetic diamond materials, tungsten carbide products, and hydrogen storage tanks. Sales channels include direct sales to industrial customers, OEMs, and distributors domestically and internationally. The environmental segment generates revenue from government-subsidized emission reduction device sales. The company also engages in export-import activities and investments in related ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ILJINDIAMOND is one of the top three global manufacturers of industrial synthetic diamonds alongside DI (formerly General Electric) and E6 (formerly De Beers). It holds approximately 10% of the global market share, competing on technology, quality, and cost. In hydrogen storage, ILJIN HYSOLUS is a leading domestic supplier with exclusive contracts with Hyundai, competing with a few global players like Toyoda Gosei and Hexagon Purus in the Type 4 tank market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 154.5 billion KRW with an operating loss of 4.4 billion KRW and net income of 10.6 billion KRW in the latest fiscal year. Total assets stand at about 594 billion KRW with a low debt ratio of around 11.7%. Despite recent profit challenges due to market conditions and subsidy reductions, the company maintains stable sales and pursues growth through R&D and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ILJINDIAMOND emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced synthetic diamond products with superior durability, precision, and performance for cutting and grinding applications across diverse industries. Its products offer extended tool life and environmental benefits. ILJIN HYSOLUS differentiates through advanced lightweight, high-pressure hydrogen storage tanks with exclusive OEM partnerships, focusing on safety, durability, and cost competitiveness to support the growing hydrogen mobility market.
